name: Agility (AGL)
description: Determines the number of invincibility frames (i-frames) during your roll and the speed at which you use items like Estus Flasks.
details: Increased by leveling up Adaptability (ADP) and Attunement (ATN). 99 AGL is a common breakpoint for 12 i-frames, similar to DS1 fast roll.

name: Poise
description: Determines your resistance to being staggered when hit by an attack.
details: Unlike DS3, DS2 poise is always active. Heavier armor typically provides more poise. Getting hit reduces your poise meter; when it hits zero, you stagger.

name: Soul Memory
description: The total number of souls you have ever collected. This determines your matchmaking tier for co-op and invasions.
details: This system prevents high-level players from invading low-level players, but it also counts souls spent on items or lost upon death. Use the Agape Ring to stop collecting souls.

name: Power Stance
description: A unique mechanic in DS2 that allows you to dual-wield weapons with a special moveset.
details: Requires 1.5x the Strength and Dexterity requirements of the weapons. Hold the 'two-hand' button to enter Power Stance if compatible weapons are equipped.
